meegaan.en: go with someone; go with them

texto: To propose a joint plan is said «Ga je mee naar...?» (do you come to...?). If you're excited, you say «Ja, leuk!» (yes, that's good!) or «Ja, graag!». If you can't go, the polite formula is «Sorry, dan kan ik niet; ik werk» (I'm sorry, then I can't; I work). «Wat jammer!» (what a pity / what a pity!) is used to lament it and another time is suggested: «Zullen we zondag gaan?» (do we go on Sunday?).

frases.nl: Ga je zaterdag mee naar het park?
frases.en: Are you coming to the park on Saturday?

frases.nl: Sorry, zaterdag kan ik niet; ik werk.
frases.es: Lo siento, el sábado no puedo; trabajo.
frases.en: I'm sorry, I can't do it on Saturday; I work.

frases.nl: Wat jammer! Zullen we zondag gaan?
frases.en: What a shame! Shall we go on Sunday?

frases.nl: Ja, leuk! Om twee uur bij de ingang?
frases.es: ¡Sí, genial! ¿A las dos en la entrada?
frases.en: Yeah, great! Two o'clock in the driveway?

bloques.pregunta: What Dutch expression is usually used to lament a plan that cannot be made («What a pity!»)?

opciones.explicacion: It is the usual exclamation to express empathic sorrow or disappointment.
It means «That's good!» or «What fun!», the opposite of pity.
It means «You're welcome.», it does not express contrariness.

bloques.pregunta: Why can't Tom go to the park on Saturday?
bloques.frase: Sorry, zaterdag kan ik niet; ik werk.

opciones.texto: Because he's got work shift that day.
opciones.explicacion: «Ik werk» explains the work reason he is not free.

opciones.texto: Because he has to take care of his little brothers.
opciones.explicacion: It does not mention family obligations.

opciones.texto: Because she's meeting her doctor at 2: 00 in the afternoon.
opciones.explicacion: You have no medical consultation planned.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the alternative day proposed by Mila for a walk.

opciones.explicacion: Mila proposes to go on Sunday («zondag») to the unavailability of Saturday.
Saturday is the day Tom works and can't attend.
They don't propose to see you on a working day like Monday.

bloques.pregunta: What conclusion does Mila and Tom reach at the end of the dialogue?

opciones.texto: They close the deal and agree to see you on Sunday at the park entrance.
opciones.explicacion: «Afgesproken» confirms the agreement and «tot zondag» seals the meeting.

opciones.texto: Cancel the exit definitely for lack of time
opciones.explicacion: They don't cancel it, they've moved it on Sunday at 2: 00.

opciones.texto: They decide to go shopping to a covered mall
opciones.explicacion: They keep the plan to go to the park.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the exact meeting point agreed in the park.

opciones.explicacion: «De ingang» is the entrance or access door to the enclosure.
They are not left at a public transport stop, but at the entrance to the park.
They're not left at any inside table.
